On Bonfire Night, families and friends gather to light big bonfires and watch fireworks light up the sky. It’s a fun time with sparklers, hot chocolate, and yummy treats like toffee apples. People also build scarecrows called "guys" and put them on the bonfire. It’s all about being together and enjoying the bright lights and warmth of the fire.
